description: Tasks template for Azure migration of Asset Manager Kit application

tasks.description: Generate Bicep IaC files to provision Azure infrastructure resources
tasks.requirements: Generate Bicep templates to provision: Azure Blob Storage account for asset storage, Azure Service Bus namespace with queues for message processing between web and worker modules, Azure Database for PostgreSQL flexible server. Configure Managed Identity for all services to enable secure authentication. Include all necessary parameters and outputs for service integration.
tasks.taskSummary: Generated 11 Bicep IaC files to infra/ folder: main.bicep orchestrating modules for Managed Identity, Azure Blob Storage (with assets/thumbnails containers), Azure Service Bus Standard namespace with image-processing queue, and Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server. All resources configured with Managed Identity RBAC assignments. Includes parameters.json, deploy scripts, and documentation.

tasks.description: Migrate storage operations from AWS S3 to Azure Blob Storage
tasks.requirements: Migrate all file storage operations from AWS S3 to Azure Blob Storage in both web and worker modules. Replace AWS SDK (software.amazon.awssdk:s3) with Azure Storage Blobs SDK. Update file upload logic in web module and file access logic in worker module for thumbnail generation. Use Managed Identity for authentication to Azure Blob Storage. Maintain consistent storage access patterns across both modules.
tasks.taskSummary: Replaced AWS SDK S3 with Azure Storage Blobs SDK (azure-storage-blob:12.24.0) and azure-identity:1.11.0 in both web and worker modules. Created AzureBlobStorageConfig (DefaultAzureCredential) and AzureBlobStorageService/AzureBlobStorageFileProcessingService replacing AwsS3Config/AwsS3Service/S3FileProcessingService. Updated application.properties in both modules. Storage type changed from s3 to blob for consistent message routing. Build passing, unit tests passing, 0 CodeQL alerts.

tasks.description: Migrate messaging from RabbitMQ to Azure Service Bus
tasks.requirements: Migrate message processing from RabbitMQ (spring-boot-starter-amqp) to Azure Service Bus. Update web module to send thumbnail generation messages to Azure Service Bus. Update worker module to consume messages from Azure Service Bus for processing. Use Azure Service Bus JMS integration to minimize code changes. Configure Managed Identity for authentication. Maintain message format compatibility between producer and consumer.

tasks.description: Migrate database connectivity to Azure Database for PostgreSQL
tasks.requirements: Update database configuration to connect to Azure Database for PostgreSQL flexible server. Configure Managed Identity authentication using Azure AD for secure, credential-free database access. Update JDBC connection strings and Spring Data JPA configuration in both web and worker modules. Ensure compatibility with existing entity mappings and repository interfaces.
